page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 504.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance includes local NVMe SSD storage, though it does not bundle any graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the z4d-highmem-64-standardlssd balances high-capacity memory with dedicated compute resources and fast local NVMe SSD storage. This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring high-throughput, low-latency storage access alongside substantial memory capacity. The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is centered on its specialized storage and memory density, making it a structured choice for data-intensive operations where local scratch space or caching is critical, avoiding the overhead of external network-attached storage.

This server configuration is suited for large-scale database deployments, high-performance transactional databases, data warehousing, and intensive ETL processes. The combination of 64 dedicated vCPUs, 504.0 GB of RAM, and local NVMe SSDs supports demanding enterprise applications, real-time analytics, and memory-heavy storage workloads without the need for GPU acceleration.
